id.description: The unique identifier for the workbook.

contentUrl.description: The URL name of the workbook, used in URLs to access the workbook.

webpageUrl.description: The full URL to the workbook on the server.

showTabs.description: Whether the workbook shows views as tabs.

size.description: The size of the workbook in bytes.

createdAt.description: The date and time the workbook was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time the workbook was last updated.

encryptExtracts.description: Whether extracts in the workbook are encrypted.

defaultViewId.description: The ID of the default view in the workbook.
